newsitem.title: CHINA: Banque Paribas opens first China branch.
newsitem.headline: Banque Paribas opens first China branch.

text.p: France's Banque Paribas on Thursday officially opened its first branch in China, located in Shanghai's Pudong New Area, bank officials said.
The bank currently also has representative offices in three other Chinese cities -- Beijing, Dalian and Guangzhou.

China's central bank has insisted that foreign banks with branches in Shanghai wishing to do local currency business must open a branch in Pudong, east of Shanghai's city centre, which the authorities wish to make into a major financial centre.

Only nine foreign banks in Shanghai have so far received permission to do very limited Chinese yuan business in Shanghai. All other foreign bank branches in China are restricted to doing foreign currency business.
